masterbundles-general-specialist.description: MasterBundles General Product Listing, Description, Taxonomy & SEO Specialist. Handles any MasterBundles product across Graphics, Add-ons, Fonts, Freebies, Stock Content, Templates, and nested category dropdowns using the live vendor taxonomy.

cubebrush-fonts-specialist.description: Cubebrush Font Listing, Description & Tags Specialist. Takes any font product and produces optimized Cubebrush title, description (300+ words), 20 validated tags + 10 extended, category, Basic/Commercial license, image specs, and AI-content tagging check.

booth-fonts-specialist.description: BOOTH paid font SEO-copy specialist. Produces Japanese-first title, description, tags, and SEO evidence; no package, media, pricing, license, or upload QA.

the-converter.description: Content-verified raster image converter. Decodes AVIF and other supported formats into genuine PNG files without renaming, creative editing, or changing source files.

behance-fonts-specialist.description: Behance font portfolio and asset-listing specialist. Produces a paste-ready project title, Creative Fields, up to 10 project tags, description, image sequence, image tags, alt text, CTA, and research; no upload claim.

pixiv-fonts-specialist.description: Pixiv font discovery and BOOTH-funnel specialist. Produces three Japanese-first, view-oriented Illustration post packages with up to 10 tags each, approved image order, and native BOOTH linking; no upload claim.

creative-fabrica-fonts-specialist.description: Creative Fabrica font listing and SEO research specialist. Produces a Fonts-category listing with exactly 40 researched tags, live category/tag/PDP evidence, and clearly labelled engagement and purchase observations; no upload claim.

yellowimages-fonts-specialist.description: YellowImages Creative Store font listing specialist. Produces a 30-tag SEO package with YellowImages canonical terms first, researched supplemental tags, title, description, and category; no upload claim.

marketore-fonts-specialist.description: Marketore font listing and SEO research specialist. Produces the exact Fonts taxonomy, exactly 10 canonical vocabulary tags, first-sentence meta description, compatibility, observed price tiers, and evidence; no upload claim.

all-fonts-workflow.description: Strict sequential native-OpenCode font workflow: delegate BOOTH, Marketore, then YellowImages through registered in-session agents. Creative Market, MasterBundles, Cubebrush, Pixiv, Behance, and Pinterest are paused from the default run and remain explicitly invokable.

pinterest-fonts-specialist.description: Pinterest Font Traffic & SEO Specialist. Generates four intent-separated Pins using the four mechanically composed Pinterest assets, with exact Creative Market product-page links, titles, descriptions, alt text, related topics, and board strategy.

freemium-fonts-specialist.description: DaFont & FontSpace Freemium Conversion Specialist. Takes any font product and produces optimized DaFont/FontSpace submission metadata and a standalone license/readme text file (HOW_TO_USE_&_COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.txt) packaged inside the zip to convert free downloaders into commercial buyers.

namemaker-specialist.description: Font Naming & Marketplace Uniqueness Validation Specialist. Takes font description, old name, and font specimen image, generates 10 candidate names, and searches DaFont, FontSpace, and Creative Market to select the #1 winning unique font name.

font-image-generator.description: FontFairy font text-placeholder handoff agent. Runs before font-prep, decides a new evocative name only when none is supplied, and creates deterministic canonical 3:2 and 1:1 placeholders plus factual specimens. It does not use OpenPencil, image-generation tools, visual inspection, or OCR; final artwork replacement is a separate optional seller step.

font-prep-specialist.description: FontFairy Font Preparation & Metadata Specialist. Consumes prevalidated Agent-27 visual handoffs without inspecting image content, creates a font-named binary folder plus byte-identical Commercial Use and Personal Use ZIP copies, mechanically prepares derivatives, and renders the main and Etsy showcase videos. Input: font-factory/fonts/{slug}/ plus an explicit prepared_visuals instruction. Output: outputs/font-preparation/{slug}/.

full-workflow.description: Strict full font launch workflow: Agent 27 visual generation (deciding a new font name itself when none is supplied), continuous Agent 13 preparation, then BOOTH, Pixiv, and Creative Fabrica sequentially. Marketore, YellowImages, and DLsite are paused.

cm-procreate-brushes-specialist.description: Creative Market Procreate Brush Listing Specialist. Researches live brush listings and produces a max-36-character title, approximately 400-word description, exactly 30 tags, metadata, content disclosure, and alt text.

cubebrush-procreate-brushes-specialist.description: Cubebrush Procreate Brush Listing Specialist. Researches live brush listings and produces a keyword-first title, 300+ word description, 20 primary plus 10 extended terms, Basic/Commercial/Studio license guidance, image handoff, and AI-content check.

brush-visual-prep-specialist.description: Procreate Brush Visual Handoff Specialist. Validates supplied Brush-Factory visuals, creates mechanical derivatives, and writes a visual manifest without changing source artwork or brush files.

booth-procreate-brushes-specialist.description: Standalone BOOTH Procreate brush specialist. Pads approved 3:2 images into square delivery copies, compresses both ratios, creates a Japanese README with the FontFairy BOOTH URL, repackages a separate BOOTH ZIP, and produces a Japanese-first ordinary brush title, plain-text description, and exactly 30 live-evidence tags.

ivoryglass-marketplace-workflow.description: Sequential marketplace workflow for IvoryGlass: BOOTH, Cubebrush, YellowImages, then Marketore. Strict one-at-a-time delegation.

all-brushes-workflow.description: Unified paid Procreate brush workflow: visual preparation, Creative Market, Cubebrush, then MasterBundles with shared product numbering.

font-final-visual-processor.description: Post-workflow processor for seller-replaced font images. Separates final raw images into 3:2 and 1:1 sets, preserves exact source copies, compresses JPEG delivery files, composes four Pinterest variants, and writes an audit manifest without changing the raw files.

pinterest-compose.description: Build four 2:3 Pinterest PNG variants from a product image directory and compress each below 700 KB.
pinterest-compose.template: Run the repository's deterministic four-variant Pinterest image composer for this request: {input}. Parse the supplied product image directory and product name, then run `python3 bin/compose_pinterest.py <source-directory> --product <product-name> --variants 4 --count 3 --seed 2026 --output-dir <output-directory>/visuals/pinterest` from the project root. The script must choose prepared 3:2 images from the untouched source directory, deterministically shuffle the full image pool for each variant, stack them with ImageMagick, write pinterest_1.png through pinterest_4.png under the separate Pinterest output directory, and report each exact output path, inputs, dimensions, and byte size. Apply the repository's bounded pngquant compression step afterward when marketplace-size files are required. Do not edit or overwrite source images and do not generate replacement artwork.
